_নিয়ম: pseudo-code ছাঁচ। slots: সিদ্ধান্ত-id → slot; options: বিকল্প-id → লেখা (string/list) বা {slot: লেখা}; templates: mode-id → লাইন ('?slot ' দিয়ে শুরু হলে লাইনটা ঐচ্ছিক (slot ফাঁকা থাকলে বাদ), '!slot ' দিয়ে শুরু হলে শুধু slot ফাঁকা থাকলে)। id-র শেষে -sc থাকলে (শূন্য-থেকে-train-এর নকল) আসল id-র তথ্য নেয়। loss এখানে বিকল্প-ভেদে বসে (ft-learn-from)।
noMode: # ওপরে বা ডান পাশের বোতামে বাছো: Fine-tune করব, নাকি শূন্য থেকে Train করব।
# তারপর প্রতিটা সিদ্ধান্ত বাছলে এখানে pseudo-code তৈরি হবে।

options.opt-baseline-prompt: base model + a good prompt, no training
options.opt-baseline-fewshot: base model + few examples in the prompt
options.opt-fmt-chat: conversations of (system, user, assistant) turns, in the model's chat template
options.synthetic-data: synthetic rows generated by a stronger model, then filtered for invalid/near-duplicate items
options.opt-human-sample: a human checks a sample of the data
options.opt-split-group: group/time (rows from one source stay in one split)

continued-pretraining.signal: raw text; labels come from the text itself (next token)

preference-optimization.loss: preference_loss(policy, frozen reference, chosen, rejected)   # e.g. DPO: a simple classification-style loss

rl-based-tuning.signal: reward from an environment or a reward model
rl-based-tuning.loss: −expected_reward + KL(policy ‖ reference)   # KL keeps the policy near the SFT model

knowledge-distillation.signal: outputs of a larger teacher model

options.opt-loss-answer: only answer tokens (and <end>) count; question tokens have mask 0 (no loss/gradient, still context)
options.selective-fine-tuning: trainable = chosen layers/parameters; freeze the rest
options.bias-only-bitfit: freeze everything except bias terms; trainable = biases
options.parameter-efficient-fine-tuning-peft: PEFT: freeze base; train only a small added/selected part
lora-low-rank-update: for each target weight W: W_eff = W + (alpha/r) · B · A      # A: r×in, B: out×r, B starts at 0
qlora: store frozen W in 4-bit (NF4), compute in higher precision
for each target weight W: add LoRA update (alpha/r) · B · A; trainable = {A, B}
options.rslora: LoRA, but scale = alpha / sqrt(r)  # stable when r grows
options.adalora: LoRA with the rank budget allocated per module by importance
options.dora: split W into magnitude and direction; LoRA updates the direction, magnitude is learned
options.pissa: init A,B from the principal singular components of W; freeze the residual
options.loftq: quantize W, then init A,B to compensate the quantization error
options.adapter-layer: insert a small bottleneck block after sublayers; trainable = adapters (not mergeable)
options.soft-prompt-prefix: prepend learned vectors to the input/attention; trainable = those vectors (not mergeable)
options.ia3: learn per-channel scaling vectors on activations; trainable = vectors
options.opt-lora-all-linear: targets = ALL linear layers; r = 64; alpha = 16   # QLoRA paper setup
options.opt-lora-small: r = 8..16; alpha = r or 2r; targets = chosen first
options.opt-warmup: warmup (lr rises from small at the start)
options.opt-lr-search: search on validation with small runs
options.opt-sc-lr-small-first: search with small runs first, then scale up
options.opt-stop-val: stop when validation loss rises; keep the best checkpoint

opt-amp.memory: precision = mixed (bf16/fp16 compute, fp32 master weights; fp16 needs loss scaling)

opt-grad-ckpt.memory: activation_checkpointing = ON   # activations recomputed in backward: less memory, slower

opt-grad-accum.memory: accumulation_steps = N   # effective_batch = per_device_batch × devices × N

options.opt-ddp: data parallel: full model copy per GPU, gradients synchronised
options.opt-fsdp: sharded: parameters, gradients and optimizer state split across GPUs
options.opt-ckpt-best: keep the checkpoint with the best validation score
options.opt-ckpt-resume: save regularly so a stopped run can resume
options.llm-as-judge: LLM-as-judge, checked against a human sample
options.opt-human-read: a human reads ~50 answers side by side
options.opt-regress-set: a small old-abilities test set, run before and after
options.opt-deploy-merge: merge: W_final = W + (alpha/r)·B·A → one standalone model
options.opt-deploy-adapter: keep base + adapter separate; load the adapter at serve time (record the base name/version)
options.correction-dataset: collect model errors; verify the correct answer from a reliable source; add to train; keep test unchanged
options.opt-weekly-review: review a sample of errors weekly to spot patterns
options.opt-sc-pretrained-exists: a suitable pretrained model exists → use the Fine-tune path
options.opt-sc-no-pretrained: no suitable checkpoint, data is sufficient → train from scratch
options.opt-sc-learning: a small model, for learning only
options.opt-sc-heldout: a held-out test set, used once at the end
options.opt-sc-blockstack: a stack of identical blocks (token mixer + channel mixer + norm + residual)
options.opt-sc-layout-uniform: all layers use the same mixer
options.opt-sc-layout-interleave: interleave the mixers layer by layer at a fixed ratio
options.opt-sc-layout-parallel: attention heads and SSM heads in parallel inside each layer
options.opt-bs-linear: batch × k → learning rate × k (linear scaling), with warmup
options.opt-bs-noise: pick the batch near the gradient noise scale (critical batch size)
options.opt-bs-accum: gradient accumulation: several small batches per update
options.opt-wd-search: search weight decay on validation with small runs
options.opt-clip-1: clip the global gradient norm at 1.0
options.opt-clip-avg: clip at a threshold set from the average gradient norm
options.opt-search-grid: grid search over a few hyperparameters
options.opt-cosine: cosine decay to 10% of the peak
options.opt-sc-stop-val: stop when validation loss stops improving (patience); keep the best weights
options.opt-sc-stop-budget: fixed step or token budget matching the schedule length
options.opt-sc-lr-recipe: start from a published recipe, then check with small runs
options.opt-sc-shape-depth-width: layers and hidden size chosen for the parameter budget
options.opt-sc-shape-kv: fewer KV heads than query heads (GQA)
options.opt-sc-shape-cache: compute the KV cache first: 2 * kv_heads * head_dim * attention_layers per token
options.opt-sc-shape-tokens: scale training tokens with parameters (about 20 per parameter)
options.opt-kd-text: the teacher's written answers become the student's SFT data
options.opt-kd-probs: match the teacher's token probabilities (soft targets, KL)
options.opt-kd-hidden: also match the teacher's hidden vectors (projection if sizes differ)
options.opt-kd-same-arch: student has the teacher's architecture, smaller or equal
options.opt-kd-diff-arch: student has a different architecture (see the conversion methods)
options.opt-kd-offline: fixed examples written once by the teacher (offline)
options.opt-kd-onpolicy: the student writes, the teacher gives signal on that text (on-policy)
options.opt-kd-filter-answer: keep only answers that match the known correct answer
options.opt-kd-filter-agree: keep answers the teacher repeats consistently

mode-finetune: # ===== আমার পথ: Fine-tune (আগে-শেখা model থেকে) — pseudo-code =====
# ‹? …› মানে এই সিদ্ধান্ত এখনও বাছোনি; বাছলে লেখাটা নিজে বদলে যাবে।
# ‹সাধারণ মান› মানে বাছোনি বলে প্রচলিত ডিফল্ট ধরা হয়েছে; নিজে বাছলে বদলে যাবে।
baseline = {{baseline}}            # tuning-এর আগে এটা মেপে রাখো
# ধাপ ২ — Input (আগের model, নতুন data, সেটিং)
use base.tokenizer and base.config           # একই checkpoint-এর, মেলাতে হয়
train, val, test = split(data, by = {{split}})   # test তুলে রাখো, শেষে একবারই দেখো
# ২গ. সেটিং: কোন parameter বদলাবে, কত জোরে
pred = model(micro_batch.input)            # শুরুতে হুবহু checkpoint-এর মতো
report = compare(baseline, tuned_model, on = test, metrics = metrics)
mode-scratch: # ===== আমার পথ: শূন্য থেকে Train — pseudo-code =====
# ‹? …› মানে এই সিদ্ধান্ত এখনও বাছোনি; বাছলে লেখাটা নিজে বদলে যাবে।
# ‹সাধারণ মান› মানে বাছোনি বলে প্রচলিত ডিফল্ট ধরা হয়েছে; নিজে বাছলে বদলে যাবে।
train, val, test = split(data, by = {{split}})   # test তুলে রাখো
loss = task_loss(model(batch.input), batch.target)   # যেমন next-token cross-entropy
